description.en: Generic spiral-coprolite morphology, not a taxonomic type replica. Primary substitute Rummy et al.2021 Fig2 O-R provides dense body, tapered versus flatter ends and broad coils; original inventory Coy1995 page available only as abstract. Three coils,0.09m body length, matrix, relief emphasis and colors are art choices, not specimen measurements. No producer species, diet or exact internal anatomy asserted; Cretaceous is example-scoped. Raised-fossil-relief convention retained.
